profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Versatile software developer with product and platform experience ranging from product feature to operations work. Recurse Center alum (S1'14 and S1'16). I love to write code that has a visible and tangible effect for its user base, whether that's full-stack feature development, or devtools or other internal tooling. I get most excited about digging into large, complicated code bases to do debugging, refactoring, and performance work. I care deeply about writing sustainable code and building reliable, maintainable systems. I look for jobs and coworkers that practice a learning and growth mindset, have implemented blameless postmortems, don't believe in 10x engineers, and prioritize kindness and curiosity as the qualities best suited to building powerful engineering teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and wrote specifications for critical customer features used by healthcare providers for billing, scheduling, and business operations.
- Owned backend work for key provider notes feature, including using SQL to reconcile disparate data sources, and contributed to additional frontend features to ensure project completion & delivery.
- Planned and led team contribution to a project aiming to consolidate and standardize communication between all front- and backend services by migrating to a single public reverse proxy gateway service.
- Worked cross-functionally across engineering teams to integrate systems necessary to enable provider scheduling feature.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · React.js · PostgreSQL · Node.js · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Brooklyn, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Spearheaded a solo reorganization of Etsy’s header on mobile web, developing and A/B-testing new features in PHP and Javascript.
- Planned and executed several major upgrades to Etsy’s search infrastructure in GKE and Prometheus, including Kubernetes operation, front-end web development, and writing documentation.
- Improved search infrastructure performance and resilience through refactoring and more refined scaling strategies, editing search entrypoints in PHP, and managing cluster workloads.
- Served as a member of the Mentorship Working Group to coordinate and support mentor/mentee pairs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Researched and documented a cloud disaster resilience plan for the entire Search platform.
- Managed Kubernetes clusters, including supporting infrastructure in Terraform and Prometheus, initially on-premises in Etsy’s datacenters and then in GKE.
- Helped develop, build, and publicly document a custom-made canary rollout tool for cloud deployments as part of the Search Platform team.
- Managed Etsy’s Chef server and migrated it to a Chef HA cluster in GCP.
- Aided in Etsy’s migration from on-prem datacenter servers to GCP and documented entire migration process.

positions.title: Participant
positions.description:
- Built a computer starting from basic logic gates, following Nand2Tetris’ coursework.
- Built a web app to imitate genetic mutation of a literary text over time.

positions.title: Infrastructure Developer
positions.description:
- Worked on internal tooling and infrastructure using Chef, Sensu, GoCD, Postgres, and AWS.
- Built Ruby gems to manage Chef workflows.

positions.title: Support Tools Developer
positions.description: Created new features and endpoints in the internal Customer Support portal, working full-stack, using Angular 1 and Ruby.

positions.title: Process Analyst
positions.description: I documented internal IT processes, and aggregated and standardized already-existing documentation.

positions.title: Technology Support Coordinator
positions.description: I fixed Mac and PC software issues and helped people explore how to best use their computers' capabilities.

positions.title: Help Desk Technician
positions.description: I answered computer-related questions and solved software issues on student computers.

positions.title: Participant
positions.description: Built a text adventure and Twitter bot in Python.

positions.title: Clerk
positions.description: Guided customers (expert to beginning gardeners) in their plant-buying decisions, including ecological choices involving native plants.

positions.title: Reading Tutor
positions.description: Tutored second-grade students one-on-one in reading and supervised the class in the hallways.
